description: Fallback tier for machines with very limited RAM (<8GB). Use only when heavier models cannot run.
Smaller default model (~2.7GB). Recommended for ≥16GB RAM hosts when you want a lighter footprint.
Balanced model for ≥16GB RAM hosts. Use when you prefer llama3.1 behavior.
Large model for ≥32GB RAM with one or more GPUs. Use only when both memory and GPU resources are available.
